subject: Exec sign-off needed: CloverPath pilot bundled credit + rate carveout
messages:
From: Lana Brooks <lana.brooks@cloverpath.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Derek Hall <derek.hall@cloverpath.com>, procurement@cloverpath.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Pilot extension + combined credit/discount request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the smooth onboarding — the team at CloverPath has been able to integrate the Redwood inference calls into our triage pipeline and the initial evaluation looks promising. We finished the six-week pilot last week and saw a 42% improvement in triage throughput on the sample workload.

Procurement reached out with a two-part ask to unblock an executive review: they need (1) a 6-week extension of the pilot (to validate at scale with our full dataset) and (2) an onramp package that combines one-time free credits (to cover pilot token usage) plus a first-year discount on a committed monthly plan when we convert.

Specifically they asked for: 
- $15k in free credits applied during the extended pilot window
- a 20% discount on the first 12 months if we commit to a 12-month Reserved Dedicated plan within 30 days of pilot completion

Procurement emailed a target approval timeline of next Friday (Nov 27) because their Q4 approvals close early. Can Redwood provide executive authorization for this combined concession? We have attached a short pilot results pack and a spreadsheet with our forecasted token consumption.

Attachments: cloverpath_pilot_results.pdf (pdf), requested_terms.xlsx (xlsx)

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Lana Brooks
VP Product, CloverPath Health
lana.brooks@cloverpath.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lana Brooks <lana.brooks@cloverpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension + combined credit/discount request

Hi Lana — really glad to hear the pilot data is looking strong, congrats to your team.

Quick clarifying Qs from procurement that would help speed an approval:
- If we provide $15k in credits, what is the minimum committed spend you expect in month 1 of the Reserved plan? (ballpark is fine)
- Who will sign the 12-month commitment on your side (we need a named signee for the deal id)?

Internally I'm looping in Marissa (sales director) and Aditya (BD/finance liaison) to route this for exec sign-off. Marissa/Aditya — can you review the attached pilot pack and provide guidance on an approval band? Procurement needs a yes/no by EOD PT on Nov 25 to make the Q4 cutoff.

If it's easier, happy to propose a combined concession that balances credits + discount and we can iterate.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
(attachment: requested_terms.xlsx referenced)

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: CloverPath concession recommendation + approval memo (for exec)

Team — quick summary and recommendation for exec approval (procurement deadline Nov 27):

Situation: CloverPath pilot shows strong technical signal; they want a 6-week extension + a commercial sweetener to convert to Reserved Dedicated. Without a concession they will delay purchase decision into next quarter.

Asks from customer: $15k one-time credits + 20% first-year discount on a 12-month Reserved plan. They estimate month-1 reserved spend of $45k (based on forecast).

Recommended concession (compromise):
- $12,000 one-time credits to be applied during the extended pilot (covering most pilot usage)
- 18% discount on the first 12 months of the Reserved plan if signed within 30 days after pilot completion
- Standard SOW & 30-day termination protection for the pilot extension

Rationale: preserves reasonable margin (vs $15k/20% ask) while giving a clear commercial incentive to convert quickly. Customer is strategic in healthcare and likely to expand if early integration succeeds.

Attachments: approval_memo.pdf (internal memo with estimated P&L and deal math), cloverpath_final_sow.docx (draft SOW with pilot extension language)

Request: Marissa and Aditya — please confirm approval or escalate to execs (VP/sales leader) if you need a higher sign-off band. If you approve, I'll send an official sign-off to Lana and trigger DocuSign for the SOW.

Thanks,
Kim

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: CloverPath concession recommendation + approval memo (for exec)

Kim / Aditya — I reviewed the numbers in approval_memo.pdf. I'm comfortable with the recommended band: $12k credits + 18% year-1 discount.

Two small asks before I mark final: please add a clause limiting credits to pilot usage only (no carry-forward) and include a conversion cadence clause that ties the discount to signature within 30 days. Once those two bullets are in the SOW language, consider this approved from Sales.

Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot extension + combined credit/discount request — Executive sign-off

Lana — thanks for the packet and for the quick turnaround. Good news: Redwood can approve a combined concession to enable your pilot extension. Below are the final, approved commercial terms.

Final approved terms (Redwood):
- One-time pilot credits: $12,000 applied to usage during the 6-week pilot extension
- Discount: 18% off list on the first 12 months of a 12-month Reserved Dedicated commitment, provided the agreement is signed within 30 days of pilot completion
- Credits are strictly for pilot usage and do not carry forward into committed billing
- Pilot extension SOW and conversion terms attached (cloverpath_final_sow.docx)

Next steps:
1) I've attached the SOW with the two requested clarifications. Please review.
2) DocuSign link for the SOW: https://www.docusign.com/TP/12345-CLP-CF
3) Procurement: once the SOW is countersigned we will allocate the $12k credit and schedule the extended pilot start date.
